description: Speaks a line of text with a local text-to-speech model and saves it as a wav. model_name picks the voice: facebook/mms-tts-eng (the default, one voice; other languages are mms-tts-<code>), suno/bark-small (distinct speakers via a voice_preset task argument) or microsoft/speecht5_tts (the voice of a reference clip via speaker_embedding). To clone a voice from a short clip and its transcript, use the voice-clone template (Edge0/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-0.6b, reference_audio with reference_text task arguments). The result declares no 'sample_rate': a generated track carries the rate its model produced it at, so saying nothing is what saves it correctly.
